name: context-guard
description: Context-budget guard for long Claude Code and Codex sessions: a Stop hook enforces a per-model checkpoint protocol (mechanical stub + budgeted memory-writer subagent on Claude; a direct stub-write instruction on Codex), and a SubagentStop tracker surfaces true session spend (main thread + subagents) on Claude. Default protocol uses only vanilla Claude Code; a scoped memory layer is detected at runtime when installed.
